summary.en-US: Save your open tabs as sessions, restore them later, and manage your bookmarks. Everything stays on your device.

description.en-US:
Save all open windows as a named session and restore it later in new windows. Search, favorite, rename, and trash sessions, and export or import them as JSON backups. You can also import exports from Tab Session Manager. Optionally manage your existing bookmarks.

Privacy: no accounts, no analytics, and no network requests. Sessions are stored locally in your browser. Private-window tabs are never saved.
